entries.id: online:Measured by the relay; typical value first, then the 95th percentile. Ping: round trip between the player and the relay. {slot0} Behind: how far the player’s game ran behind the match clock, their input delay included. {slot1} Quality is the worst of these and of reconnects, time offline and delayed orders. Offline: time disconnected before reconnecting. Delayed orders: orders that ran a tick later than asked.
